name: slides
description: >- Make and revise presentation decks in the Slides format as local files: project/deck.json holds the title, slide order, outline and typefaces, and each slide is one HTML file (project/slides/<id>.html) on a fixed 1920×1080 canvas (1440×1080 at 4:3), written as HTML with classes sharing project/deck.css or, in older decks, a closed subset of HTML and inline CSS. A local page shows the deck with a slide rail and an overview, lets people retype, move and restyle things, write speaker notes, add
author: JimLiu
